title: Bound contraction-plan structure before recursive execution
finding: ReferenceContractionInterpreter bounded relation operations but ContractionPlan accepted an arbitrarily large or cyclic expression graph. Recursive serialization, digesting, or evaluation could therefore exhaust Python recursion independently of the existing matrix-operation budget.
primary_claim: ContractionPlan now validates the complete expression iteratively against a small structural node ceiling before recursive serialization or execution can be reached; ordinary bounded plan semantics are unchanged.
gardener_decision: Add one iterative structural guard to the existing executable oracle rather than introducing a second planner, parser, graph representation, or execution layer. Keep the 256-node ceiling private to the reference implementation until measured workloads justify a different contract.
acceptance: a contraction tree at the configured structural bound remains accepted and digestible
an oversized contraction tree refuses at ContractionPlan construction
a cyclic adversarial expression terminates at the same bounded structural guard rather than recurring indefinitely
existing Fourfold multi-hop and semiring contraction behavior remains unchanged inside the bound
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

requested: bounded Tensor/Forest diagnostic on the designated Python 3.12 hash-seed 0 cell
verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert the G1-TENSOR-01AV commits; canonical Forest/Fourfold artifacts, relation blocks, and identities are unchanged.
